subject: [cluster] Add node id to log statement for closing link on first message as lightweight (#1869)
reason: The change only adds the sender node id to an existing LL_NOTICE log message when closing a cluster link whose first message was lightweight; the link-closing behaviour, packet handling, and all observable replies/state are unchanged, and hdr->sender is part of the fixed message header already validated before this point. A log-text-only change has no behaviour for a scenario to exercise.
